name: Rosa Luxemburg
shortBio: Polish-German Marxist philosopher, economist, and revolutionary theorist who formulated an anti-authoritarian theory of mass democratic spontaneity and analyzed imperialism as structurally necessary for capital accumulation.
centralQuestion: Why does genuine socialist emancipation require radical democratic pluralism and spontaneous mass agency rather than substitutionist vanguard dictatorship?

keyWorks.title: Reform or Revolution
keyWorks.description: Critique of Eduard Bernstein's evolutionary revisionism defending dialectical contradiction and structural transformation.

keyWorks.title: The Accumulation of Capital
keyWorks.description: Macroeconomic critique arguing that capitalism permanently depends on non-capitalist peripheries and imperial expansion.
